author: studio2/standalone-plugin-repos-010 task 03 (SDK proc/audio mechanism moves)
summary: Moved the generic subprocess-streaming and wav->mp3 mechanisms into the real SDK (studio_plugin_sdk/proc.py, studio_plugin_sdk/audio.py). App modules keep thin policy wrappers/re-exports; zero behavior change.

changes.change: NEW. Holds run_cmd_stream (signature unchanged: cmd, on_output, cancel_check, env=None), coerce_subprocess_output, _active_processes registry, terminate_all_subprocesses. Stdlib-only, no app.* imports. Note: the task-doc's proposed scratch_dir param was NOT added — run_cmd_stream never used TRANSIENT_DIR; only the marker helpers do, and those stayed in app.

NEW. wav_to_mp3(in_wav, out_mp3, *, quality: int, on_output=None, cancel_check=None, runner=None). runner defaults to studio_plugin_sdk.proc.run_cmd_stream (resolved via module attr at call time); the Studio host injects its own runner.

run_cmd_stream/_active_processes/terminate_all_subprocesses removed and re-exported from studio_plugin_sdk.proc (identical objects — monkeypatch sites patching app.engines.proc_utils.run_cmd_stream still work because app callers resolve it via this module at call time). File keeps app policy: TTS Server runtime-marker helpers (TRANSIENT_DIR) + orphan cleanup. 439 -> 289 lines.

wav_to_mp3 is now a thin wrapper (public signature unchanged) that injects MP3_QUALITY and the app-resolved run_cmd_stream as runner= into studio_plugin_sdk.audio.wav_to_mp3 — preserving tests that patch app.engines.proc_utils.run_cmd_stream around wav_to_mp3 (tests/engines/test_engines.py:93).
coerce_subprocess_output moved to studio_plugin_sdk.proc; re-exported here for app callers (app/api/utils.py, write_subprocess_output).

NEW. Identity tests (run_cmd_stream, coerce_subprocess_output, _active_processes registry, terminate_all_subprocesses), no-app-imports source gate for SDK proc/audio, MP3_QUALITY injection wrapper test (SDK fn mocked — R2 boundary), app-runner injection regression guard, SDK cmd-shape test. TDD: 6/7 red before implementation (ModuleNotFoundError), all green after.

invariants: Module identity (one object per function across app shim and SDK). Zero behavior change: same ffmpeg cmd, same runner resolution for existing monkeypatch sites. SDK modules have zero app.* imports.
note: Task 03 of .agent/mastermind-010-plan/. stitch_segments/get_audio_duration/finalize_sample_artifact deliberately NOT moved — only plugin studio/ (host-side) code references them.
